selection: Fixed first replication of six named settings chosen by DGP features: CD/EXP noise-dominant and inefficiency-dominant, CD/HN noise-dominant, CD/pure noise, CES/EXP noise-dominant, PWL/EXP noise-dominant. No selection by loss, fit status or whether checks pass.
scope: Procedural subset check, not a new Monte Carlo ranking or all-ten-method replication. SFA optimization is rerun using all frozen adapter rules and archived raw sfaR baseline starting values; the original R baseline fitting is not rerun. FDH uses exact archived R-read input doubles.
failure_policy: Retain every case, status and discrepancy. Return a nonzero code for review-required results; do not replace cases or relax tolerances after inspecting outputs.
